title: A2AExtensionDescriptor
description: Validates the two JSON shapes the AgentTrust A2A binding (RFC-0002) introduces: (a) the AgentExtension entry a provider declares under AgentCard.capabilities.extensions[], and (b) the trust metadata payload carried under Message.metadata['https://treessera.com/extensions/trust/v1']. The root schema accepts either shape; validate against #/definitions/agentExtension or #/definitions/trustMetadata to target one.

agentExtension.title: AgentTrust AgentExtension declaration
agentExtension.description: The A2A AgentExtension object declaring the AgentTrust extension on an Agent Card.

uri.description: The AgentTrust extension URI. This exact value identifies the extension in AgentCard.capabilities.extensions[], the A2A-Extensions HTTP header, Message.extensions[], and the Message.metadata namespace key.

description.description: Optional human-readable summary of what the extension provides.

required.description: A2A AgentExtension.required. AgentTrust providers SHOULD declare false: the extension degrades gracefully for clients that do not opt in.

params.description: AgentTrust declaration parameters. Unknown keys are permitted for forward compatibility.

principal_id.description: principal_id (RFC-0001 Principal) under which this agent produces Evidence and accrues reputation.

verification_service_url.description: HTTPS base URL of the verification service that resolves this agent's Principal, Verification Results, and Reputation Records.

trustMetadata.title: AgentTrust message metadata payload
trustMetadata.description: The namespaced object carried under Message.metadata['https://treessera.com/extensions/trust/v1'] on task result messages.

evidence.description: The RFC-0001 Evidence bundle produced for the task.

evidence_status.description: Verification status of the evidence at send time. 'pending' means no independent Verification Result exists yet; 'verified'/'rejected' mirror the verifier's verdict.

verification_result.description: The RFC-0001 Verification Result backing a 'verified' or 'rejected' status. Absent while evidence_status is 'pending'.
